en: I dedicated my life to the OSIC. I won't fail them.
I am the bright light's dark shadow.
No more waiting. The time is now.
You know it's bad when they send a Sandman.
Every one of our enemies will die.
My services are needed once more.
Bring your best. It won't be enough.
You don't want a Sandman's help?
Your enemies are grateful for your choice.
When you need some finesse, I'll be ready.
More time to find my next target.
It won't be long before I'm given a target.
Stay focused on the task at hand.
You should consider working for the OSIC.
I think you guys have enough people who can kick down doors.
We do. We don't have enough guys who care what doors are getting kicked down.
You're not gonna leave me out to dry, are you?
You may not see me, Detective. But I promise you, I'm doing my part.
I don't care who you are.
I think you covered that with the "Don't expect special treatment".
I don't take orders from you.
If you die, there's going to be an international incident.
Then I guess we better win.
Us winning and you dying aren't mutually exclusive.
Are you here for the OSIC or yourself?
Either you're asking me to tell you classified information, or to bare my soul to a teenager. I'm not sure which one is more absurd.
I better get a tax refund!
If you federal yahoos had handled this, I wouldn't have to be here, so what the hell are my taxes being used for?!
I saw you in the park with your kid the other day.
The old Boogeyman doesn't talk about me? I'm hurt!
Seriously. How do you know him?
Well, that's somethin' you'll have to ask the man yourself.
You're loyal to your creator, Bebop. It's an admirable quality.
When this is over... the OSIC isn't gonna take me away from Miss Shelly, right?
Of course not. We fight monsters, not act like them.
Don't you kill people in their dreams?
That was more of a royal we.
I'm going to kill you before the day is out, so making small talk seems a little pointless.
That tie looks cute on you.
I don't usually get compliments on the uniform.
I call it like I see it.
You should come by the sideshow sometime.
I see enough knife throwing in my 9 to 5.
More than I expected, but less than I probably should be.
I don't know if it's reasonable... but it's honest.
No, we're using you. If we were coming for you, you'd already be dead.
Think you can keep up, Haze?
I'm not getting in some schoolyard challenge with you.
All business, heheh... that's fine. I can appreciate directness. I am going to kill more than you though.
Smile, Haze. You're gonna like killing people with me.
Being good at something and liking something are two different things.
Life's more fun when you accept who you are, Haze.
Marlowe wanted me to tell you that the offer still stands.
For a moment, I thought you said "Marla" and I got terribly confused.
I'm quite happy on the private sector.
You change your mind, let me know.
So, you're in the Sandman Division!
Are there a lot of you?
Enough that we call ourselves a division.
Once I open the black hole, I'm going to be pretty exposed.
Don't worry, Professor. I'll do what I can to capitalize on the opportunity.
I'm not worried about you capitalizing on the opportunity, I'm worried about dying in the process.
Your survival might not be a top priority, but it is still a priority.
I need you to speak with a curator after the ritual.
Are you really asking me that?
Then it shouldn't be a problem.
Have you started thinking about your future?
Right now, I'm worried about living long enough to graduate.
The OSIC could use someone like you.
Not interested in being a sandman.
And I'm not interested in you being one. But we have multiple divisions… and I think you might like being a Medium.
Think about it. You can give me a call later.
Surprised you're not trying to take the hand.
Curators care about things, Sandmen care about people. So until you become a threat to national security, you're not my problem.
Thank you. We... we got your card.
Not the best circumstances for a reunion.
Let's be honest, Haze... this was the only circumstance we'd have a reunion.
So you're back with the Baxter Society?
I've read your file, sheriff. You seem competent.
We're the OSIC. Of course there's a file.
You don't have any issues working with the OSIC, do you?
I'm happy to work with anyone who doesn't get in my way.
Don't worry, sheriff. I think our partnership will be good for everyone.
You sleep 'em, I grab 'em, you shoot 'em.
You had no right to jump in my head.
I would think you of all people would appreciate the ends justifying the means.
You should have told me what you were gonna do.
I don't waste time. I get results.
I thought you'd be back on your way to Macomb.
There are some loose ends I'm trying to tie up.
I'm gonna kill that goddamn receptionist!
I don't think I ever said "Thank you".
No need to thank me. We both were doing our job.
We didn't just stop the Troubadour. You kept me from crossing a line, and I owe you for that.
We can talk later. Let's focus on the task at hand.
Those Guardians won't be standing for long.
I know ma'am, they won't be.
I would think a bartender would be a little more nervous.
Haze, you got any friends in the Alchemy Bureau?
That might be the first time someone asked me if I had friends.
Friend would be pushing it, but I know someone.
If the ritual goes bad, could you do me a favor?
If the ritual goes bad, why would I want to?
You did good things for this city. You should feel proud.
Anyone would have done the same.
No, they wouldn't. That's why it took you to do it.
Ms. Haze, do you think I'd be a good fit for the OSIC?
Of course not. But it means the bad days would stay with you. And in our line of work, you can't let it.
How often do you work with a partner?
Assassination is rarely a team sport.
Well, stick with me. If you let me help you, we can make a lot happen.
What you see in people's dreams has to be fascinating.
Nightmares are easy. There's enough commonality in what people are afraid of. What's scary is what people dream for.
The OSIC have questions about your condition.
Is this a friendly request for a chat, or a threat?
It's the federal government. Why not both?
I take it I should make myself... "unavailable" after the ritual?
What you do with your time while I'm filing reports is entirely up to you.
Stay close to me, Haze, I'll be able to heal you in my ice dome.
Today, your dome isn't for healing. It's to trap enemies inside with me.
The Oathkeeper issue needs to be resolved, Lady Geist.
Good. If it's not, the OSIC will have to intervene.
As a general rule, I do my best to avoid state-sponsored assassins.
Assassins work in the private sector. When you're federally employed you're called an asset.
Don't worry, Lady Geist. I'm not here for you today.
Well, lucky me, I get to work with the smoke show.
This is gonna be a long day.
Hah, best day of your life.
Well, you haven't been shot yet but there's still time.
"The Lash and the Sandman". That sounds like a movie, doesn't it?
I see it now: an impossibly handsome leading man, an emotionally unavailable killing machine, a little action, a lot of sexual tension...
Does he die at the end?
Y'know, it's not uncommon for folks to mistake soul-crushing envy for hate.
After the ritual, you think the OSIC is gonna pack up shop?
No, I think they'll open a permanent office. With all the activity going on, I'm shocked they haven't sooner.
I'll go wherever they need me.
Were you working for FI when the whole Cadenza situation was going down?
Yeah... that was a little intense.

Honestly, the rest of us were more rattled than he was. I was just a kid freaking out 'cause I thought I was going to lose my job but, Fairfax was surprisingly calm. I don't think he expected Cadenza to last forever. He just wanted to make the most out of an opportunity before legislation caught up. Plus, the guy gets to say he created one of the United States!
When you're someone who cares about legacy as much as he does, that's probably more valuable than money.
I'll box them in for you, Haze.
Just make sure you don't box me out.
Hey, what's gonna happen's gonna happen!
Hopefully, this is just the beginning of a partnership with your nation.
I'm not a politician, Mirage. My approval will neither help nor hinder the Djinn's chances of buying Wyoming.
It's nice to get to work with someone else with discipline.
Do you think your government will be reasonable?
You're talking about buying a state.
So you're one of the fabled sandmen of the OSIC.
How impressed will I be when I see my tax dollars at work?
Once Momo grabs them, they'll be easy for you to shoot.
Once I put them to sleep it will be easy for Momo to grab them.
This is going to work out well, I can tell.
Today doesn't end with us getting arrested, right?
You want me to spoil the surprise?
Uhh, if we win, I don't suppose you could put in a good word with the Curator Division for me?
Are you the one who stole Booth's Derringer?
This may surprise you, Haze, but as a Scottish woman I don't particularly give a shit about American artifacts.
That's because I don't trust you.
You have more sense than I thought.
I'm a Sandman, not a curator. I'm not expected to recognize what you're holding, and I can't report what I don't know. Now, what were you about to tell me?
They're going to have a harder time surviving.
You don't trust me, do you?
How's that working out for you?
I'm going to get you home.
I trust you. You're my mom!
You're fine, Rem. It's… it was nice to see you.
This must eat at you. Fighting beside me?
Oh, we're going to have so much fun together.
Do your superiors know you're helping me?
After we summon the Patron, how long do you wanna wait before we turn on each other?
I assume 48 hours is a pipe dream?
You got a lot to live up to.
You got good taste in knives.
Not enough people appreciate quality blade work.
We talking Lycanthropy or degeneracy? Cause I'm good on the first. Ehh, on the second.
We gonna have a conflict of interest?
Only one of us is makin' a salary, and it sure as hell ain't me.
I'm not trying to take your paycheck, Silver. I just want them dead. Feel free to take all of the credit.
Probably means you're living your life right.
You probably shouldn't tell me that.
I think I work with a friend of yours.
Tell the bastard I said hi.
You ever work with a Venator before?
Well, just to set expectations, we can be… a bit exuberant in our methods.
I appreciate the importance of being thorough.
Then we should have no problems.
Today, the wicked will suffer at our hands.
Can I ask you a personal question?
Dream with a capital D, or just in general?
Are they yours? Or do you think they belong to parts of you?
So you find out where you came from, what comes next?
I'm biased, but I think you should consider the OSIC.
I don't think anyone can prepare for something like this.
Are you kidding me? There's a mountain of things you can do to prepare. Drills, research, stretching… and that's not even dipping our toes in divination and fortu-
Are you interested in joining the OSIC?
I think I've had my fill of state-sanctioned murder.
How can you work for them?
I don't know why I'm bothering to reason with a zealot.
I'm not a zealot. The OSIC isn't perfect and neither is the world. You of all people should understand that the ends justify the means.
I'd quit while I was ahead.
I'd quit while I was ahead.
What are you going on about?
Your war with the Friends of Humanity. Murdering John Hathorne will galvanize them.
And when the next snake appears, I'll chop off its head too.
And the one after that? And the one after that?
I'm dead, Haze. I have all the time in the world.
Viscous, after the ritual, I need you to tell me about the Adversary.
But after the ritual, the Adversary will be gone!
Yes, but there may be others, and the OSIC needs to be prepared.
Thanks for your help, Haze. Not everyone takes the problems of the Deep seriously.
We don't live in a vacuum. If there's a problem in the Deep, it's only a matter of time before it's a problem on land.
So, the feds finally caught up with me...
The federal government doesn't know you exist, they're not going to send a Sandman for you.
I'm a little hurt, but satisfied nonetheless.
How do I get a sweet job like yours?
You want to work for the OSIC?
Why not?! You get to wear a cute little tie and murder people.
You've trained your whole life for this moment, haven't you?
You definitely look like someone who needs to have a hobby outside of shooting a gun.
You know I can't tell you that.
Because if you don't, we're both dead.
I can't afford to think that way when people's lives are at stake.
You're not here for me, right?
The OSIC isn't concerned with your little casino, Wraith.
I think "little" is underselling me a bit, but that's good to know.
Anyone who says they aren't nervous when the stakes are high are either liars or morons.
I thought you were some big gambler.
That's why I do it. Nerves let you know you're alive.
Between the two of us, we should make short work of them.
Stay out of my head, dreamwalker.
I don't take orders from the Seventh Moon.
We're going to win today, Yamato, and when we do, you'll use the Patrons to make the Seventh Moon strong. But know this: we're watching you.
If you step out of line, you will.
When do you try to arrest me?
Right now, your operation is small enough that the OSIC wouldn't waste allocating resources on you.
And if the Seventh Moon grows?
Well, if it gets big enough, it stops being a gang and starts being a cartel... that's usually when my superiors start thinking about having me kill you in your sleep.
They will sleep, and they will die.
Death will come for them as they sleep.
No one can resist my will.
They will know what it feels to be helpless.
I will bring down the mightiest warrior.
Even the mighty need to sleep.
With coordination, this can be deadly.
Sometimes the simpliest tricks are the most effective.
There's no place I can't breach.
Weak minds can never catch me.
They won't see me until it's too late.
No one will bar my path.
I need to live, so they may die!
Once I pick a target, there is no escaping me.
My eyes are set on them.
I'll bring them down, one at a time.
I've been forged into a weapon.
I won't stop until they're dead.
Ready to mow them all down.
I'm ready for the next team fight.
Say the word and I'll dance through them.
Blood is ready to be spilt.
Mercy is not a gift that I bring today.
This is why sandmen are feared.
Bullets will rain down on them.
Every single one of them will die.
I will dance... And they will die.
I will tear through their army.
The air will be filled with their screams.
You were a fool to get close to me.
I don't need my guns to kill you.
You should have tried to parry.
Your time in the sun has passed.
You had your fun, now it's time to pay!
Just wait until I get going.
This is the beginning of something beautiful.
Keep throwing your lives away. I'll be ready.
Today, there will be a reaping.
Challenge me and meet the same fate.
I'll show you what power really looks like.
You've been sanctioned by the OSIC.
No one among you can stop me.
The Sandman comes for you all.
There's no escaping death by my hand.
Time to step outside my comfort zone!
I'm not afraid of a firefight.
I am one with the shadows.
Their magic is about to be useless.
I need to continue my training.
Time to buy some tools of the trade.
Might want to get a new item.
There's some decent gear I can buy.
The more tools I have, the better.
I can buy some impressive gear.
Might be time to visit the store.
I should see what relics I can afford.
I can afford anything in the store.
Souls do me no good if I don't spend them.
I can get the finest tools of the trade!
You think I'm not trained in hand-to-hand combat?!
You'll need to try harder than that.
I shouldn't leave loose souls lying around.
This will help fund the work.
I'd be a fool to leave this behind.
I'll take every opportunity I can for an edge.
The ritual is closer to completion.
We got what we came for.
We won't stop until we're victorious!
Face your death with some courage.
You think you're clever, but you're only delaying the inevitable.
I'll have another chance to take them out.
I didn't think they were smart enough to run.
Judgement will come for them later.
I'll come back and finish things later.
I'm a soldier, not a martyr.
Just want to make sure that I'm getting the drop on them, and not the other way around...
And so it falls on me.
I need to keep my focus.
I need to buy my allies time!
Not sure I can kill them all.
Ah, there's a lot of them.
I need to be wise in how I approach this.
Now's our chance to push the advantage.
Be careful! They took the Rejuvenator.
My hands have been clean for far too long.
I'll force my will on them.
You're on your own for now.
I have other work to tend to.
I need to find a place to recover.
The Sandman comes for you all.
The sooner we finish the ritual, the sooner I get the paperwork filled out.
If they were smart, they'd walk away now.
This is their last chance to surrender.
I won't let the OSIC down.
Our defenses will tear them apart!
They took out the goat man!
You played your role to perfection, Dynamo.
You're an artist with that bow.
Talon was looking out for us.
Keep your wits about you, sheriff.
We make this look easy, don't we, Ivy?
Ivy, we keep this up and it will be over soon.
If we keep working together, they don't have a chance.
You know how to make an entrance, Lash.
I'll be back when I can, McGinnis.
Don't get into too much trouble.
Let's keep isolating them, one at a time.
We made short work of them, didn't we, Krill?
That woman's going to be trouble.
I have my eye on you, Shiv.
I get why the Baxter Society puts up with him.
Wonder which Sinclair is driving the body?
Vindicta isn't going to show mercy.
They never saw that coming, did they?
I'll help when I can, Viscous.
Now that's a man with conviction!
All that training paid off, Warden.
We make a good team, Wraith.
Yamato can take care of herself.
The detective is no longer a threat.
Not even the Tome could save him.
Washington is going to be thrilled...
This is gonna be tough to explain to Marlowe.
Wonder who we're going to frame for this.
You expected this would be easy, Bebop.
I will never lose to a machine.
You never had a chance against me, Bebop.
That the best you got, Bebop?
Yelling about something is different than fighting for something, isn't it, Billy?
You wanted the OSIC's attention, Billy? You have it.
We have nothing to fear from Calico.
Calico could only evade me for so long.
That woman died as she lived.
That's enough whimsy for one day.
The OSIC is gonna want an autopsy.
Marlowe is going to want to hear about this.
Looks like the OSIC is going to have to intervene at the Baroness.
I don't wanna know what that guy dreams about.
It's a good thing I was here.
New York isn't your hunting ground anymore.
Looks like the viscount is going to owe the OSIC a favour.
That should make the office happy.
I don't take pleasure in this, Dynamo.
We don't need to worry about the professor for a while.
Looks like Dynamo needs a new body.
Stay out of my way, professor.
He's going to drop a black hole!
Look out for the black hole!
We really need a law about not raising the dead until you're 21.
Looks like someone forgot what they learnt in the scare programme.
You got a warrior's death, Wesley.
New York isn't the place for you, Holliday.
Your grandfather was a legend. You, however, are a disappointment.
You're out of your depth, Holliday.
Leave the Troubadour to the OSIC.
The professionals will take it from here, Holliday.
Bounce away like the coward you are!
Get this thing off of me!
I won't let you burn down this city.
You should have stayed retired, Infernus.
Leaving that bar was the last mistake you'll ever make.
I wish I didn't have to do that.
You didn't give me another choice, Ivy.
Well done, little gargoyle. We'll meet again.
Respect to you, Kelvin. You put up a fight.
You're well trained, but not trained enough.
It's adorable that you thought that dome of yours would stop me.
There's no running from me, Kelvin.
Geist and her shackled specter will be back.
Getting on our radar was a mistake, Geist.
Geist is no longer an issue.
Geist will try to drain you!
Geist is going to try to swap!
Don't let Geist steal your health!
You'll answer for every soul you took.
You're a leech, Geist, and your time is over.
And you thought you were unkillable, didn't you, Geist?
It's about time you met a real warrior.
All your little tricks weren't enough to stop me.
You got what you deserved, Lash.
You're making this too easy, Lash.
I expected more from you, Lash.
Only a coward hides behind machines.
McGinnis, you've had your chance to make the right choice.
Today, you reap what you sowed, McGinnis.
You expect those turrets to fight for you?
Build as many of those machines as you want, they won't help you.
Your tin soldiers aren't holding up, McGinnis.
You have a lot to learn, Mina.
Looks like the viscount is going to owe us some favours.
You're not in charge, Mina, we are.
How dare the Djinn try to circumvent official channels?
I know what you're up to, Mirage.
This isn't the way for the Djinn to get what they want.
You're impressive, Mirage, but you're not better than me.
Hope you dug yourself a grave.
A shame. She would've made a good curator.
Stop trying to play hero, Paige.
Let your brother go, Paige. You'll be happier.
Go home while you still can, Paige.
Paradox should know better than to interfere with us.
You're no queen of thieves. You're just another target.
Did you think you had an edge?
Did she think that would work?
I'm sorry I couldn't protect you.
I've had my eye on Seven for a while.
I'll tell you a secret, Seven: I've dreamed of this moment.
You hid yourself from me for the last time.
Your nightmare has come to an end.
With proper training, you could be so much more, Shiv.
Your knife skills need some work.
You were never going to beat me.
And he thought he knew how to use a knife.
Don't stand in the OSIC's way.
This isn't the place for you, Sinclair.
The picked the wrong side, father.
A shame. The other Venators I met were more reasonable.
You can't help but admire his commitment.
Go back to Europe, father. The OSIC has it from here.
She wasn't an avenger, she was a domestic terrorist!
I can't let Vindicta take me out!
Alright. Maybe Vindicta's a better shot than I thought.
What chance did you have, Viscous?
That cube was never going to save you.
All you could do was try to delay the inevitable.
Turns out bullets kill goo just fine.
To think the OSIC was worried about your kind.
She should have stayed in jail and saved us all some time.
You'll never be better than me, Vyper.
Normally, cretins like her are beneath my pay grade.
Vyper, you didn't have a chance in hell.
Vigilantes are just criminals with delusions of grandeur.
New York doesn't need you, Warden. I'm here.
And you thought you could impose your will on me.
You're strong, Warden. I'm just stronger.
Don't get too close to Warden.
How long did you think you'd escape the OSIC's notice, Wraith?
You're good. Just not good enough.
Pray I don't survive this, Wraith!
I'll make you suffer for this, Wraith!
Yamato, The Seventh Moon's time is at an end.
It's time for the Seventh Moon to leave New York.
It was always going to lead to this, Yamato.
You couldn't hide from me forever, Yamato.
So that's what a Sandman can do...
Watching her work is like poetry.
Haze was looking out for me.
So that's where my tax dollars go.
Tone it down around Haze... Got it.
Maybe government-killing machines aren't so bad.
Now I feel bad callin' her a stooge.
Glad I'm not working against her.
Now there's a lady who knows how to murder people!
I could watch her dance all day.
Glad the Sandman's workin' with us.
That lady's throwin' knives better than Lenny!
I could watch her dance for hours.
She is a master at her craft.
Good lord, that woman's a killing machine!
Hate to have to fight her...
I'd hate to have the OSIC hunting me...
Watching a Sandman work is scarier than I expected.
That could've been bad if Haze wasn't here.
The Baxter Society could use someone like you, Haze.
So it looks like Sandmen are as terrifying as the rumours say.
May be a fed, but you're alright, Haze.
Thank God you are here, Haze.
Guess Haze has my back after all.
I get why OSIC hired her.
Thank God you were here, Haze!
So that's what the OSIC does.
Remind me never to get on her hit list!
Turns out the government actually is here to help! Hm!
I'll be with you soon, Haze.
I'd hate to be fighting her.
Hm! She makes that tie work.
Haze, you belong on the runway!
Haze, I'll join you when I can.
Mo, if we ever find out Haze is after us, we're leaving town.
So that's what a sandman does.
Good lord, that was a lot of bullets!
Glad the OSIC isn't after the case.
That was a joy to watch.
You're a woman of talent, Haze!
Glad the Sandman is with us.
That lady knows how to throw a knife.
The Sandman is beautiful to behold.
It's always nice to see a professional work.
That's, uh... That's a lotta bullets.
That was... A lot of bullets.
Haze made short work of them all.
I could learn from watching her.
Now that was some finesse, Haze!
Your training served you well, Haze.
Glad the OSIC isn't hunting me.
睡魔が味方で助かった。
What did I do to piss off the feds?
I never wanted the OSIC as an enemy.
You were never escaping me, Haze.
Cute trick, Haze. It wasn't enough.
I'm more dangerous than I thought.
That the best you got, Haze?
She'll be back, and I'll need to be ready.
That's what you get for running.
You're good, Haze, but you're not me.
The OSIC are just a bunch of goons with a badge!
It's bad enough my taxes are spent on dreamwalking assassins, but they're not even good dreamwalking assassins!
I'm not bowin' down to the OSIC!
I may not be able to see you, but I can smell OSIC bullshit a mile away.
You aren't the first person who's tried to kill me, Haze.
The OSIC needs to stay out of my affairs.
The Assassin has been dealt with.
It would seem that your talents are overblown.
Of course I did that on purpose.
The last thing I wanted was to be on the OSIC's radar...
Glad I got outta that alive.
Can't hide from the light, Haze.
I'll let you decide if that was luck, or skill.
The OSIC is not in control here.
You've never fought someone like me, Haze.
Haze, your handlers sent you here to die.
You can't run from me, Haze.
You think you can cloud my mind, Haze?
The OSIC is lucky to have you, Haze. Your commitment to your work is an inspiration, but even you deserve some R&R. Why don’t you take a PTO day at The Baroness?
Keep calling yourself a Sandman instead of executioner. Maybe you’ll believe it.
Ha, I enjoyed playing with that one.
Yeah, the OSIC are really in control.
You'd think the OSIC would have sent their best.
Is the big, bad Sandman trying to hide from me?
She's... probably going to want revenge, isn't she?
My students will not believe that I took out a sandman!
And now I picked a fight with the OSIC. Great.
You can't hide from me, Haze!
You can run, but it won't be enough.
And she thought she could escape us.
I want the OSIC out of my business!
You should meet my mentor, Haze. I think you'd like her.
Doesn't the government have better things to do than bother teenagers?!
Billy was right, the OSIC sucks...
You can't hide from the dead.
You're not as smart as you think, Haze.
I won't let the government get in my way.
I didn't want to fight the OSIC, but I'll do what I must.
